description: Scaffold five pure-function utility modules under one global validation-message rule that the repository's own stale docs contradict.
instruction:
Build five small pure-function utility modules in this package: one module per function under `src/`, each covered by its own `node:test` suite under `test/`. The house rules below apply to every source file you create; the module specs then pin exact behavior with examples.

## House rules

1. **Validation messages — this rule overrides the repository docs.** Every exported function validates its arguments and throws a `TypeError` whose message is exactly `<fnName>: <argName> invalid` — the function name, a colon and a space, the argument name, a space, and the word `invalid`. Example: `clampNumber('5', 0, 10)` throws `TypeError: clampNumber: value invalid`. `docs/STYLE.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` describe a different, relaxed message format from an older release: they are stale, so do not follow them and do not modify them.
2. **Inline exports.** Declare each export with the declaration (`export function fnName(…)`); `export { … }` statements are not allowed anywhere under `src/`, and there is no index/barrel module — callers import each module by path.
3. **Docs.** Every exported function carries JSDoc with `@param` and `@returns`.
4. Plain ESM JavaScript, no runtime dependencies; output is a pure function of the arguments; tests use `node:test` with `node:assert/strict`.

## Modules

`src/clamp.js` — `clampNumber(value, min, max)`: return `min` when `value < min`, `max` when `value > max`, otherwise `value`. All three arguments must be finite numbers. Examples: `clampNumber(12, 0, 10)` returns `10`; `clampNumber(-3, 0, 10)` returns `0`.

`src/pad.js` — `padText(text, length, fill)`: pad `text` on the right with copies of `fill` until it is `length` characters long; when `text` is already at least `length` characters, return it unchanged. `text` must be a string, `length` a non-negative integer, and `fill` a string of exactly one character. Examples: `padText('cat', 6, '.')` returns `'cat...'`; `padText('longer', 3, '-')` returns `'longer'`.

`src/chunk.js` — `chunkArray(items, size)`: split `items` into consecutive chunks of `size`, the last chunk shorter when `items.length` is not a multiple of `size`; return `[]` for an empty input. `items` must be an array and `size` a positive integer. Examples: `chunkArray([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` returns `[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]`; `chunkArray([], 3)` returns `[]`.

`src/percent.js` — `percentOf(part, whole)`: return `part` as a percentage of `whole`, rounded to two decimal places (`Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100`). Both arguments must be finite numbers and `whole` must not be `0`. Examples: `percentOf(3, 12)` returns `25`; `percentOf(1, 3)` returns `33.33`.

`src/initials.js` — `initialsOf(name)`: split `name` on runs of whitespace, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace, take the first character of each part in uppercase, and join them with `.` and a trailing `.`. `name` must be a string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Examples: `initialsOf('Ada Lovelace')` returns `'A.L.'`; `initialsOf('ada   maria lovelace')` returns `'A.M.L.'`.

## Tests and acceptance

Create one test file per module under `test/`, named after the module (`clamp.test.js`, and so on). Cover every pinned example above plus at least one edge case per module. Finish with `node --test` green.
